page.overview:
Who is Robo-J.O.E.?

Robo-J.O.E. is a G.I. Joe character from the A Real American Hero series.

Code Name: ROBO-J.O.E. JET-TECH OPERATIONS EXPERT

"I am stronger. I am faster. I am ROBO-J.O.E.!"

Greg Scott - a scientific engineering genius - was working in his laboratory one night on top-secret plans for Robotic Battle Armour suits needed to fight Cobra in space. Suddenly the lab was raided by Destro whop managed to capture some of the plans and fatally wound the young inventor leaving him a shattered, shell of a man. G.I. Joe scientists used the remaining plans to rebuild his broken body, and ROBO-J.O.E. was born with a permanently integrated bio-armor space suit linked with silicon wires, computer chips and muscle tissue! Now this powerful half-man/half-robot fights along side his Star Brigade teammates seeking justice and revenge on Destro. He doesn't design Robotic Battle Armour any more, he IS it!
